# TokenBar

TokenBar shows OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Krill, Custom providers, and other AI coding usage limits in the macOS menu bar.

Canonical documentation:
- TokenBar: https://y0shua1ee.github.io/TokenBar/ - Tiny macOS menu bar app that keeps your Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Antigravity, Droid (Factory), Copilot, and z.ai limits visible.

Source: https://github.com/y0shua1ee/TokenBar
